mapper.sql: id, phone, password_hash, name, name_updated_at, avatar, email, role, status, first_login, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (phone, password_hash, name, role, status, first_login) VALUES (#{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{role}, #{status}, #{firstLogin})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()

SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_login_log ll ON ll.user_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 'CANDIDATE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ll.login_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND ll.login_status = 1
SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_profile up ON up.user_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 'CANDIDATE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND up.resume_public = 1
